title: omr literature-review paper_bank
description: Structured corpus produced by /omr:literature-review. Append-only; dedup by canonical id.

schema_version.description: Tracks the omr plugin version that wrote the corpus; resolved at write time from {{omr_version}}.

slug.description: Workspace slug. Matches the parent directory name.

research_question.description: Copied from scope.yaml at write time; updated on refresh.

id.description: Canonical paper ID. DOI preferred (e.g. 10.1234/abcd), then arXiv ID (e.g. 2401.12345), then sha1-12 hash of title for sources without identifiers.

authors.description: Author list as array of strings. Never empty, never ['TBD']. Drop the entry if unknown.

venue.description: Conference / journal short name. Empty / null for preprints.

url.description: Real paper page. DOI > arXiv > publisher / Semantic Scholar. Never blank, never a placeholder.

source.description: Comma-joined list of source IDs (in order of first appearance) when the paper was returned by multiple sources. Valid IDs: zotero, local, exa, tavily, brave-search, huggingface, github, web.

retrieval_query.description: The query string that returned this paper, for audit.

screening.description: Filled by Phase 4 (screening) when added in a follow-up PR. Null in MVP.

notes.description: Free-form notes from synthesis or screening; user-editable.
